title: Beyond the Matrix Sign: Quadratic Spectral Descent
abstract: arXiv:2609.07597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Muon can be interpreted as optimizing a linear local objective over a spectral-norm ball. This gives a matrix-sign update that preserves the singular directions of the gradient and assigns the same magnitude to all active singular modes. We ask whether these two properties remain optimal when local curvature is taken into account. To answer this question, we keep Muon's spectral-norm constraint unchanged and replace the linear local model with a quadratic one. We call the resulting method \emph{Quadratic Spectral Descent} (QSD). We show that curvature can change both the singular values and the singular directions of the optimal update. To make QSD practical, we approximate curvature with Kronecker-factored statistics and solve the constrained quadratic with a small number of Frank--Wolfe steps, each of which has a closed-form matrix-sign subproblem. translated_title: 超越矩阵符号：二次谱下降
translated_abstract: Muon可以被解释为在谱范数球上优化线性局部目标。这产生了一个矩阵符号更新，该更新保留梯度的奇异方向，并为所有活跃的奇异模式分配相同的幅值。我们提出疑问：当考虑局部曲率时，这两个性质是否仍然最优？为回答这一问题，我们保持Muon的谱范数约束不变，将线性局部模型替换为二次模型，并将由此得到的方法称为二次谱下降。我们证明，曲率可以同时改变最优更新的奇异值和奇异方向。为了使QSD具备实用性，我们使用Kronecker分解的统计量来近似曲率，并通过少量Frank–Wolfe步骤求解该受约束的二次问题，其中每一步都对应一个具有闭式解的矩阵符号子问题。我们进一步提供了最优性证书，并在相同条件下与Muon进行了比较（摘要截断）……
tldr: 本文提出二次谱下降（QSD），在保持Muon谱范数约束的前提下将线性局部模型替换为二次模型，证明曲率会改变最优更新的奇异值和奇异方向，并通过Kronecker分解曲率近似与少量Frank–Wolfe步骤使该方法实用化。
en_tdlr: QSD generalizes Muon by replacing its linear local model with a quadratic one under the same spectral-norm constraint, showing that curvature changes both the singular values and directions of the optimal update, and is made practical via Kronecker-factored curvature and a few Frank–Wolfe steps with closed-form matrix-sign subproblems.
